title: C17 Client form state-machine

files_forbidden: all app/(challenges)/* directories not belonging to this task

acceptance_criteria: A multi-field checkout/profile form is driven by a useReducer-based state machine with explicit states (e.g. editing / validating / submitting / error / success) and dirty-tracking per field.
Cross-field validation is enforced (at least one rule depends on two fields) and blocks submission while invalid.
Submission goes through a Server Action, and server-returned field errors are merged back into the form state and displayed on the correct fields (not just a generic banner).
NOTES.md explains the state-machine design and why a reducer/state-machine is preferred over scattered useState for this form.

The c17 _meta folder contains spec.md (non-empty acceptance criteria), defend-it.md (3-5 from-memory questions with model answers), verification.md, and a discoverable challenge.config.ts; data is read/written via local _lib over lib/data without editing lib/data.
output_format: code plus plain English explanation of every non-obvious decision
